items: 1 cup coarsely chopped fresh spinach leaves

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.body: In a large saucepan, stirring occasionally until the onion becomes transparent: **4 Tbsp butter**, **1 Tbsp olive oil**, **1 cup finely diced onion**, **½ cup finely diced celery** and **2 cloves garlic**, minced.

steps.title: Add the flour
steps.body: Whisk in **¼ cup flour** and stir for about 1 minute.

steps.title: Add the dairy and broth
steps.body: Whisk in and simmer until thickened: **1 quart half and half** and **2 cans chicken broth**.

steps.title: Add the rest
steps.body: Stir in **½ tsp salt**, **½ tsp dried thyme**, **½ tsp dried parsley flakes**, **¼ tsp ground nutmeg**, **1 cup finely shredded carrots**, **1 cup coarsely chopped fresh spinach leaves**, **1 cup diced cooked chicken breast** and **1 × 16 oz ready to use gnocchi**.

steps.title: Heat through
steps.body: Simmer until heated through. Add salt as needed.
